# Display Error

![Display Error function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/error/04-display.svg)

[Error functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Reports status, code, location and description; the selected dialog mode controls runtime presentation. Placing this node opens no dialog.
